title.original: Mell: Memory-Efficient Large Language Model Serving via Multi-GPU KV Cache Management
title.zh: Mell：通过多 GPU KV 缓存管理实现内存高效的大型语言模型服务
title.en: Mell: Memory-Efficient Large Language Model Serving via Multi-GPU KV Cache Management

inclusion_reason.zh: Mell 提供可复用的多 GPU KV 负载监控、请求迁移与在线调度机制，属于推理集群运行时而非模型能力改进。
inclusion_reason.en: Mell contributes a reusable multi-GPU KV load monitor, request-migration mechanism, and online scheduler, making it serving runtime infrastructure rather than a model improvement.

abstract.zh: Mell 面向多模型、多 GPU 推理中的瞬态 KV 缓存失衡问题，在请求迁移成本可控的前提下动态重分配缓存负载。系统将自适应迁移机制与在线调度算法结合，目标是在满足服务需求时减少所需 GPU 数量。
abstract.en: Mell manages transient KV-cache imbalance across multiple GPUs and concurrently served models while explicitly accounting for migration cost. It combines adaptive request migration with online scheduling to reduce the GPU capacity needed for a workload.

problem.zh: KV 缓存随请求长度和生成过程动态增长，导致 GPU 间内存负载不均；直接迁移请求又会引入昂贵且难以预测的通信开销。
problem.en: Dynamically growing KV caches leave GPU memory unevenly loaded, but moving an active request can itself impose substantial and unpredictable communication overhead.

approach.zh: 作者设计自适应请求迁移策略，在计算收益与通信代价之间动态取舍，并为允许迁移的多 LLM、多 GPU 调度问题构造在线算法。
approach.en: The system adapts migration decisions to current compute and communication conditions, then applies an online algorithm for joint multi-LLM request placement and migration.

system_design.zh: Mell 运行时持续观察各 GPU 的 KV 占用和资源条件，仅在迁移能缓解瓶颈时搬移在途请求；调度器同时控制放置与迁移次数，以较少 GPU 承载整体请求流。
system_design.en: At runtime, Mell observes per-GPU KV pressure and resource conditions, migrating in-flight requests only when rebalancing justifies the transfer. Its scheduler jointly chooses placement and limits migration frequency while minimizing active GPU demand.

key_results.zh: 原型评测表明，Mell 相比既有服务系统可减少所需 GPU，并提高 GPU 利用率。
key_results.en: The prototype evaluation reports that Mell needs fewer GPUs and raises GPU utilization relative to existing serving systems.

limitations.zh: 摘要级证据未说明不同模型切换频率、互连带宽和极端长请求下的迁移尾延迟，因此节省 GPU 的幅度仍依赖具体工作负载与集群拓扑。
limitations.en: The abstract does not break down migration tail latency across model-switch rates, interconnects, or extreme context lengths, so capacity savings remain workload- and topology-dependent.

workloads: multi-LLM request streams with dynamic KV-cache load

notes.zh: 工作负载、集群形态与两项上限结果来自官方 arXiv 摘要；具体 GPU 型号、基线名称和逐表条件待全文审计。
notes.en: The workload, cluster shape, and two upper-bound results come from the official arXiv abstract; GPU models, named baselines, and table-level conditions await full-text audit.
